mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0) and weak employment growth (PAYEMS < 132000) indicates labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market slowdown (HOUST < 500) combined with weak GDP growth (GDPC1 < 11000) signals reduced consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate directly reflects labor market slack, suppressing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with UNRATE above 8.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95) indicates reduced manufacturing output, signaling economic contraction and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 210) coupled with restrictive monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 0.5) increases real interest rates and equity risk premiums, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and tight monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in consumer spending (RSAFS < 330000) indicates weak demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS < 330000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
